✗ Pod/api-123 is unhealthy

ROOT CAUSE
  The scheduler found no node that can run this Pod

  The scheduler evaluated 3 node(s) and rejected all of them. These are the
  reasons it reported, unchanged.

  Evidence
    nodesEvaluated   3
    message
      0/3 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient memory, 1 node(s) had untolerated
      taint {gpu: true}. preemption: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 No preemption
      victims found for incoming pod.
    reason           2 Insufficient memory
    reason           1 node(s) had untolerated taint {gpu: true}
    requests.cpu     1
    requests.memory  8Gi

  Possible causes
    • no node has enough free capacity for the Pod's requests
    • the Pod's requests are larger than any single node can offer
    • the nodes carry taints the Pod does not tolerate

  Suggested actions
    Compare the Pod's requests with the capacity the nodes have left.
      kubectl describe nodes | grep -A5 'Allocated resources'

    Review the taints on the candidate nodes and the tolerations on the Pod.
      kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TAINTS:.spec.taints
